App_Blurb: SailFish veDEX is the leading decentralized exchange on EduChain, powering liquidity for EduFi dApps in the Open Campus ecosystem. As the first veDEX on EduChain, it distributes 100% of protocol fees to users through Vote-Escrow and (3,3) game theory mechanisms. Users can swap tokens with optimized routing and low slippage, provide liquidity to earn rewards, participate in prediction markets for EDU/USDC prices, and bridge assets from BSC and Arbitrum. With features like staking EDU to mint stEDU for passive yields and a Builder SDK for integrations, SailFish combines speed, efficiency, and community-driven incentives. It supports Yuzu Points earning through on-chain activities, transforming DeFi into a rewarding experience for traders and builders alike.
Features: Smart Swap with V3 liquidity and optimized routing for better prices and lower slippage.
Liquidity Farming: Provide liquidity and vote on pools to earn fees, Yuzu Points, and eventually $SAIL.
EDU Bridge for seamless asset transfers from BSC and Arbitrum to EduChain.
Builder SDK: Integrate SailFish V3 trading logic into custom dApps via NPM.
Stake EDU to mint stEDU, a rebasing token sharing 40% of protocol fees with no lockups.
Purchase USDC onchain using card or bank transfer - in limited countries only atm
Ways_to_Get_Yuzu_from_DApp_Use: Connect your wallet to SailFish veDEX to track on-chain activity.
Trading Badge -> Perform token swaps with at least 5 pairs (must include USDC/EDU and EDU/wstEDU) totalling $1000 in volume (4,000 per badge) - max 5 available
Crypto Basket -> Provide liqudity worth at least $5000 on any pair of your choice - keep it locked until end of season (40,000 per badge) - max 50 available
The Crossover -> Bridge BSC > ARB > EDU with a total of 1000 EDU (2,000 per badge) - max 100 available
Stake stEDU - YUZU incentives at a 2:1 ratio, 2 EDU staked = 1 Yuzu - extended staking periods increase Yuzu Allocation - so stake early
Mint Open Campus badges for extra rewards: Ambassador (5000 pts, refer 25+ people), Community Builder (5000 pts), Quest Lord (10000 pts, complete 10 quests).
Social Tasks - e.g. x.com posting competitions. Keep an eye on their X and join their discord
